# Rejected Field Archive proof — 5deb099

Status: **rejected by the maintainer; historical evidence only**.

This proof was materially closer than `30d7401`, but its dominant regions were
measured from a labeled comparison image rather than the untouched approved
concept. The comparison label strip introduced a 56-pixel vertical offset,
leaving the crown, Calendar, Planning, and side rails too low. It also retained
generic Calendar toolbar treatment, omitted the Calendar legend, compressed
Planning controls, and simplified representative placement and attention
details.

These captures must not be used as an acceptance or golden baseline. The
untouched approved issue #118 concept remains normative.
